note: The font catalog gate's shared rule list (4C Decision 31), read by FontCatalog::validate (Rust) and scripts/check-font-catalog.mjs (JS). Every violation is reported as one of `rules`.

rules.schema: the catalog's shape: fields, types, no unknown fields
rules.licence: licence.spdx is in `licences` (no NC, ND, share-alike or GPL font exceptions)
rules.https: every URL (sources, licence, homepage) is https
rules.immutableUrl: every source URL names a 40-hex commit (a path segment, or after @) or a /releases/download/<tag>/ path
rules.sourceHost: every source URL's host is in `sourceHosts` (GitHub release downloads, raw files at a commit, jsDelivr at a commit), with no user info
rules.size: every size is between 1 byte and maxSize
rules.format: file formats are in `formats`, archive formats in `archiveFormats`
rules.scripts: scripts are ISO 15924 codes (Xxxx); an entry has at least one
rules.unique: entry ids, style ids within an entry, file sha256s (except a variable file, see `variable`), face indexes within a file and face keys (family|weight|italic) are unique
rules.variable: a file's variable.wght is [min, max] with min <= max and covers its style's weight; a file listed under several styles is variable and declared identically each time
rules.faces: a file has faces; defaultFace is one of them and matches its style's italic, and its weight unless the file is variable
rules.sources: a style has at least one source
rules.archive: an archive source states the archive's sha256 and size and a relative member path; a plain source states neither
rules.fallback: fallback ids are unique and name entries
